eps.t: Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider
eps.ov: Tanzaburo Tojima has always idolized Kamen Rider, to the point of wanting to be him. He turns 40 this year...
eps.ta: توجيما يريد أن يصير كامن رايدر
eps.oa: لطالما اتخذ «تانزابورو توجيما» «كامن رايدر» مثلاً أعلى، حتى صار يريد أن يكونه. وهو يبلغ الأربعين هذا العام...

eps.ov: Yuriko Okada has always idolized Electro-Wave Human Tackle. But seeing Tojima forces her into action...
eps.oa: لطالما اتخذت «يوريكو أوكادا» «تاكل»، إنسانة الموجات الكهربائية، مثلاً أعلى. لكن رؤيتها «توجيما» تدفعها إلى الفعل...

eps.t: I Love the Moment When Hate Turns to Love
eps.ov: After their encounter with the real Shocker, Tojima meets someone who knows more about the evil organization.
eps.ta: أحب اللحظة التي ينقلب فيها الكره حباً
eps.oa: بعد مواجهتهم «شوكر» الحقيقية، يلتقي «توجيما» من يعرف أكثر عن المنظمة الشريرة.

eps.t: Who Is the Strongest Kamen Rider?
eps.ov: Mitsuba's girlfriend, Yukarisu, transforms into a Shocker Combatant and attacks Yuriko!
eps.oa: «يوكاريسو»، حبيبة «ميتسوبا»، تتحول إلى مقاتل من «شوكر» وتهاجم «يوريكو»!

eps.ov: Mitsuba's girlfriend, Yukarisu, is a member of Shocker. What will he do protect her from his brother, Ichiyo?
eps.oa: «يوكاريسو»، حبيبة «ميتسوبا»، عضوة في «شوكر». فماذا يفعل ليحميها من أخيه «إيتشيو»؟

eps.ov: The gang gathers at a pub to discuss what's happened. But it's owner is Ichiyo and Mitsuba's resentful sister.
Nakao has a fateful encounter that makes him recount how he ended up as a Shocker-idolizing yakuza.

eps.t: What's a Kamen Rider Do When A Dangerous Enemy Appears?
eps.ov: Tojima and the gang now know that both Shocker and monsters are real. What's next?
The tournament to decide the strongest begins, with Yukarisu and Tojima facing off.
Yuriko and Tojima clash, with her superior technique frustrated by his bottomless resilience and power...
Both worn out from their previous battles, the tournament concludes with Mitsuba VS Yuriko.

eps.t: I'll Take All You Riders On
eps.ov: The gang has an unexpected encounter at Futaba's pub.

eps.t: I Will Fight, and Die, Against Shocker
eps.ov: Futaba's rage towards her brother, Ichiyo, reaches it's breaking point.

eps.t: I Want to Learn More About Humans
eps.ov: Will Futaba still be able to deny the existence of Shocker when she finds herself in a fight against Kumota?
An encounter with a man from Sena's past deepens Kumota's curiosity about humans.

eps.t: An Imposter Can't Beat the Real Deal
eps.ov: Thunder Raiko finally comes for Yukarisu. Will the Riders be able to protect her from the Shocker assassin?

eps.t: Everyone In The World Will Join Shocker
eps.ov: Tojima reels from the most recent battle, while Ito, Sato, and Ishige stumble onto Bat Man's wicked plot...
Nakao and his underlings find a surprising sanctuary, as the Bat Man's Shocker idols continue to hunt them.

eps.t: It'd Be an Honor to Die as a Rider
I Was Craving a Battle With Shocker
eps.ov: Ichiyo introduces Nakao to someone who seems poised to figure out what it is he's lacking.
Thunder Raiko tracks Nakao down, but his training has made him more than she can handle at first.
Tojima and his fellow Riders unite, out to stop the Bat Man's mass recruitment scheme for Shocker.
The Bat Man intends to convert every visitor at an arena into a Shocker Combatant. Can the Riders stop him?
Tojima and the Riders finally square off against the Bat Man. But can humans really defeat a Shocker monster?
